about.title: About Jiacheng Netting
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Netting Supplier
about.description:
Shandong Jiacheng Chemical Fiber Products Co., Ltd. is a professional and leading manufacturer engaged in the production, research, development, and sales of high-performance warp knitting plastic nets . Our factory is located in Zhanjia Industrial Park, Shanghe County, Jinan City, Shandong Province, covering an area of approximately 20,000 square meters and equipped with modern production equipment and a top-notch technical team.

We focus on the production of plastic nets, including construction safety nets, hail nets, shade nets, shade sails, olive nets, bird nets, privacy screens, weed barrier fabric, wind barrier nets, aquaculture nets, and other warp knitting products. We have advanced production processes and technologies that support customization of plastic nets in various specifications, colors, and processes.

As an enterprise driven by innovation, we have a high-quality research and development team that continuously develops and manufactures new products to meet the ever-changing demands of our customers. We place great emphasis on product quality and technological innovation and have obtained BSCI and NFPA 701 certifications to ensure the safety and stability of product quality and production environment.

Our products have been exporting to North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Africa, and other countries, receiving high praise and recognition from customers. We will continue to improve product quality and service levels, providing customers with the highest quality products and services.

faq.q: What is HDPE debris netting used for?
faq.a: Safety debris netting is used on construction sites to contain falling debris, dust, tools and job site materials, and to serve as scaffolding enclosure, guardrail barrier, building wrap and construction windscreen.

faq.q: What mesh opening should I choose?
faq.a: This netting is available in 1/8" and 1/16" mesh openings. The 1/8" opening offers a good balance of debris containment and airflow, while the finer 1/16" opening provides tighter containment for smaller particles and dust.

faq.q: Will the netting unravel when cut to size?
faq.a: No. The HDPE netting is knitted so it will not unravel when cut, and it features reinforced eyelet holes for easy and secure installation on scaffolding or structures.

faq.q: Can I order a custom color?
faq.a: Yes, the netting is available in any color. Contact us with your color and quantity requirements and we will confirm availability and lead time.

products.name: Construction Safety Debris Netting
products.description: High density knitted polyethylene mesh netting (100% virgin HDPE). 1/4" mesh hole opening. Fire-Retardant: Meets NFPA 701 Method II. Edges are hemmed & reinforced for easy installation. Will not unravel when cut. Stays flexible in cold weather. Any color is available.
applications: Safety fence, barrier net, snow fence

faq.q: What is square mesh debris netting used for?
faq.a: Construction safety debris netting with a 1/4" square opening is used for guardrail debris protection, scaffolding and building enclosure, industrial plant and refinery maintenance, demolition containment, and as safety fence, barrier net or snow fence.

faq.q: What is the mesh opening size?
faq.a: This netting has a 1/4" square hole opening. The edges are hemmed and reinforced for durability on site.

faq.q: Will it unravel if I cut it?
faq.a: No, the knitted HDPE construction will not unravel when cut, which makes it easy to trim to the exact size needed on the job site.

faq.q: Is it suitable for cold-weather work?
faq.a: Yes, the netting remains flexible in cold weather, making it suitable for winter construction and demolition projects.

faq.q: What is a mesh tarp used for?
faq.a: Mesh tarp is used for construction building and scaffolding enclosure, privacy and wind barriers, shade cloth, covering loads on dump trucks, and plastering, stucco, EIFS and masonry work.

faq.q: How is the mesh tarp secured?
faq.a: It features brass grommets every 2" along with double-stitched, reinforced hems, so it can be tied or fastened securely for enclosure or load-covering applications.

faq.q: What mesh opening does it have?
faq.a: The tarp has fine 1/16" openings, providing good containment while still allowing airflow.

faq.q: Can I order a custom color?
faq.a: Yes, the mesh tarp is available in any color to match your project or branding needs.

products.name: Weed Barrier Fabric
products.description: Made of Heavy-Duty Professional Grade Polypropylene Material, chemical free, durable, sturdy and corrosion resistant. Keeps the soil healthy. Heavy duty weed blocker fabric is needle-punched to transmit water and air, preserving the soil moisture. Fabric allows air and water through, superior permeability to keep the soil nourished. Just water cleaning to be reusable.

faq.q: What is weed barrier fabric used for?
faq.a: Weed barrier fabric is used as an underlayer for artificial grass, and for vegetable patches, flower beds, ground cover, gardens and driveways.

faq.q: Does it let water through?
faq.a: Yes, the fabric is needle-punched for water and air transmission with superior permeability, so water and air can pass through while blocking weeds.

faq.q: Is it chemical free?
faq.a: Yes, the fabric is chemical free, durable and corrosion resistant.

faq.q: Can it be reused?
faq.a: Yes, the weed barrier is reusable and can be cleaned with water for repeated use.
